body:
Proposal ID: **P10**. See the [research backlog](https://github.com/olafweller/kaspa-privacy-initiative/blob/main/docs/INITIAL-ISSUES.md).

Define what must be public, replicated, reconstructable, or user-backed-up.

Cover commitments, nullifiers, encrypted delivery, witnesses, retained L1 history, pruning/archives, backups, and deterministic reorg recovery. Demonstrate a clean independent rebuild and a valid exit; a root or a safe halt alone does not meet I-10.

Evidence, concrete objections, and specification proposals are welcome. Keep verified source facts separate from hypotheses. This is a research task; no mainnet experiment, real funds, or production cryptography.
title: [P10] State availability and recovery specification
